title: Novu — SaaS Dashboard
excerpt: A complete UX overhaul for an open-source notification infrastructure dashboard, reducing user onboarding drop-off by 34% and streamlining workflow setup.
fullDescription: Novu is an open-source notification infrastructure helping engineering teams orchestrate email, SMS, push, and chat channels. We led a full end-to-end redesign of their web console, transforming a cluttered developer interface into an intuitive visual workflow editor with dark mode and real-time event telemetry.
challenge: The previous dashboard suffered from excessive cognitive overhead. Developers struggled to build multi-channel digest workflows, leading to elevated support tickets and high drop-off during the initial 14-day trial period.
solution: We restructured navigation around visual canvas nodes, simplified API key provisioning to two clicks, and implemented a live interactive previewer showing real-time notification states across mobile and web clients.
testimonialQuote: Eliott delivered our redesign in record time and the quality blew us away. Our conversion rate jumped 28% in the first month. Absolutely recommend.

title: Finlo — Fintech App
excerpt: Marketing site and onboarding flow for a personal finance app targeting young professionals, built with lightweight animations and crystal-clear value props.
fullDescription: Finlo empowers Gen Z and millennial professionals to automate smart savings, track investments, and optimize everyday subscriptions. We designed and coded the public landing experience and pre-registration onboarding tunnel.
challenge: Traditional finance apps intimidate first-time investors with jargon and spreadsheets. Finlo needed an approachable, vibrant identity that established deep cryptographic security trust.
solution: Built interactive interest compound calculators, sleek glassmorphic financial telemetry graphs, and frictionless social authorization with instant email verification.
testimonialQuote: Working with Eliott is a dream. He asks the right questions, moves fast, and the final result always exceeds what we imagined. Our best hire of 2024.

title: Orea — Creative Agency
excerpt: Bold editorial site for a Paris-based branding studio. Scroll-driven animations and custom transitions to match their premium positioning.
fullDescription: Orea is a luxury creative and branding studio crafting visual identities for high-fashion maisons and boutique hospitality groups. The digital presence demanded artistic restraint, razor-sharp typography, and theatrical scroll-driven reveals.
challenge: Standing out in the Paris creative ecosystem requires an unforgettable digital tactile experience that performs smoothly on every device without battery-draining overhead.
solution: Developed hardware-accelerated transitions, asymmetrical grid layouts with responsive fluid typography, and custom curated imagery showcases.
testimonialQuote: We had a tight deadline and a vague brief. Eliott turned both into a polished site in under two weeks. Clean code, zero hand-holding needed.

title: Lumina — Multi-Brand Design System
excerpt: A unified cross-platform design token architecture and component library supporting 4 distinct enterprise white-label products.
fullDescription: Lumina harmonizes design and development velocity across 60+ engineers. Includes automated Figma token sync, strict accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and dark mode theming out of the box.
challenge: Fragmented CSS libraries and inconsistent UI patterns across 4 subsidiary apps were doubling frontend maintenance costs and causing visual regressions.
solution: Established a central token taxonomy for color, elevation, spacing, and typography with strict semantic contracts and automatic multi-platform code generation.
testimonialQuote: Eliott's design system completely transformed how our design and engineering teams collaborate.

title: Pulse — Real-Time Health & Fitness
excerpt: Cross-platform mobile application interface for connected biomechanical wearables with biometric heart rate zoning and recovery telemetry.
fullDescription: Pulse pairs with next-generation sensor bands to monitor athlete exertion, sleep debt, and strain recovery. Designed with high-contrast OLED dark themes and thumb-friendly navigation.
challenge: Displaying complex physiological time-series data without overwhelming users during outdoor runs and workouts under direct sunlight.
solution: Utilized glanceable circular progress rings, clear color-coded heart rate intensity bands, and high-visibility typography.
testimonialQuote: The cleanest fitness UI we've ever launched. Athletes love the instant visual feedback.

title: Terra — Zero-Carbon Commerce
excerpt: High-velocity storefront for sustainable lifestyle products featuring transparent supply chain verification and carbon offset tracking.
fullDescription: Terra combines ethical commerce with modern digital storytelling. Customers can inspect supplier origins, certified fair trade audits, and net-zero delivery impact directly in the cart.
challenge: Educating consumers about sustainable sourcing without adding friction to the purchase funnel.
solution: Designed streamlined 2-step checkout with micro-donations and live carbon offset verification badges integrated into product cards.
testimonialQuote: Our sales doubled within two months of launching the new storefront. The design communicates our values effortlessly.
